videos.title: Yes or No #1: Should I text first this week?
videos.review_summary: 【審閱用】第 1 集題目：這週要不要先傳訊息？開場：IG「如果有個安靜的聊天室一直在你腦子裡轉，停在這裡」，TikTok「這週該先傳嗎？覺得對了就暫停」。

platforms.label: Instagram
platforms.caption:
Should you text first this week? Pause the Reel. Wherever it stops is today's answer.

If you've been opening and closing the same quiet chat, here is one thing to try whichever way it lands. Before you type anything, write one clear sentence of what you actually want from their reply. Read it back. If it still feels true, you'll know what you're reaching out for.

Comment TEXT or 📱 and I'll send what your answer can mean for that first text.

This is for reference. For a serious question, book a personal reading via the link in bio.

For entertainment and self-reflection.

platforms.label: TikTok
platforms.caption:
Pause when it feels right. Wherever it stops is your answer for this week. Write one sentence of what you want from the reply before you text. More readings on IG @ainsoflighttarot, link in bio.

For entertainment and self-reflection.

changes: 全片 9 秒、可無縫循環：開場 Hook 2.5 秒 → YES／NO 快閃 4 秒 → CTA 2.5 秒，結尾淡回開場，背景與音樂也接得起來。
快閃段每 6 格硬切一次 YES／NO（共 20 段），沒有淡入淡出或翻牌動畫；任何時間點暫停，看到的都是完整的一個答案。
牌面改為手繪 YES／NO 牌：羊皮紙牌面，YES 是金色太陽、NO 是銀色新月；不用 RWS 牌圖、不放羅馬數字。
關鍵字照 rainybless 原文：YES「allowing yourself to be seen」、NO「patience」；TikTok 版不放留言關鍵字，CTA 改導向 IG。

changes: 開場第 0 格就看得到 Hook 和閃光的蓋牌，不再是空畫面淡入；同一張牌從開場一路留到揭曉，只換文字。
翻牌改成有緩動的 YES／NO 嚴格交替，最後一翻是 NO 再落在 YES，落定時有 Sage 光圈和關鍵字框。
節奏收緊：20.0 秒 → 18.5 秒；CTA 三行依序浮現，結尾直接接回開場方便循環播放。
字級全面放大（內文至少 34 px）、暫停提示移進安全區；翻牌加極輕提示音、落定加柔和和弦，無人聲。
畫面文案一字未改（20 句逐句比對核准稿）；封面改為專屬設計，不再擷取影片畫面。
